prompt: Why does the clerk reject leaving the case on the side counter?
promptZh: 庫房管理員為什麼不把箱子留在旁邊的櫃台？

options.text: The radio case will not fit there.
options.whyZh: 管理員沒提尺寸，問題是櫃台沒人看管。

options.text: Nobody is there to watch it.
options.whyZh: 管理員明說不想把箱子留在無人看管的櫃台。

options.text: The stewards are using the counter for batteries.
options.zh: 引導人員正在那個櫃台放電池。
options.whyZh: 晚到的人要向庫房管理員領備用電池，沒人說側櫃放電池。

options.text: The case still needs to be packed.
options.whyZh: 管理員提到的是裝滿的箱子，不是等待裝箱。

explanationZh: 管理員明說不想把箱子留在無人看管的櫃台。
evidence: I’m the storeroom clerk. I can’t sign them out to myself. Could your crew leader come to the desk? I don’t want to leave a full case on the unattended side counter.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: I’m the storeroom clerk. I can’t sign them out to myself. Could your crew leader come to the desk? I don’t want to leave a full case on the unattended side counter.

vocabulary.note: 表示櫃台暫時沒人看守，不代表櫃台故障。
